tldr: Mercury in the 3rd house routes the mind and voice through voice and daily mind.
body: With Mercury in the 3rd house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. This makes how you speak, study, write, listen, and move through the immediate world a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through voice and daily mind.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in voice and daily mind.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
